title: BPW-2026-0542
text:
[BUREAU OF STREET SERVICES]
BPW-2026-0542
CD ALL
PERMANENT DECOMMISSIONING AND REMOVAL OF PUBLIC TOILET – FIFTH STREET AND HILL STREET
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE the permanent decommissioning and removal of the closed public toilet at Fifth Street and Hill Street and restoration of the sidewalk at the site.
